title: ujumbe parser pack
description: One institution's SMS rules. The engine (ParserPack.fromYaml) is the authority; this schema is for editors and reviewers.

id.description: Stable identifier; must equal the pack's directory name.

name.description: Display name shown in My accounts.

version.description: Semantic version of the rules. Bump it whenever a rule changes.

min_engine.description: Oldest engine version (SemVer 2.0) that can read this pack. Defaults to 0.1.0. An engine older than this refuses the whole pack. It must be at least the version of every feature the pack uses: 0.2.0 for own_account, currency or an empty rules list, 0.3.0 for owed, due or due_format, 0.3.1 for min_engine on a rule, 0.4.0 for the loan_repayment type or institution on a rule; the engine rejects a pack that understates it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for amounts in this institution's messages that print no currency of their own.

utc_offset.description: Offset of the wall-clock times printed in messages, e.g. +03:00 for Kenya.

senders.description: Sender IDs to read. Compared case-insensitively. No two packs may share one.

rules.description: Tried in order; the first match wins. Empty for a review-only pack, whose messages all go to the review inbox.

timeFormat.description: How to read the captured `time` group. Tokens: d dd M MM MMM yy yyyy H HH h hh mm ss a; 'quoted' text is literal.

direction.description: Fixed direction. Use this or direction_values, not both.

direction_values.description: Maps the captured `direction` text (case-insensitive) to in or out.

min_engine.description: Oldest engine version (SemVer 2.0) that can read this rule. An older engine skips just this rule (reported in ParserPack.skippedRules) and reads the rest of the pack; its messages go to the review inbox. Needs the pack's own min_engine to be 0.3.1 or newer.

institution.description: The pack id of the institution whose account the money moved on, when it is not this pack's own: a bank's confirmation of an M-Pesa payment to its paybill is mpesa. Needs min_engine 0.4.0.

pattern.description: Dart regular expression. Named groups allowed: receipt, amount (required), direction, counterparty, account, own_account (the holder's own account number), currency (the code printed with the amount; else the pack's), balance, fee, time, owed (total still owed, e.g. Fuliza) and due (when it is due, read with due_format).
